## Under the hood
- **The server is split into modules** – `server.js` (2,300 lines) is now just the HTTP server and the API routes; the rest lives in `lib/`: configuration, messages, outgoing requests, the service clients, library images and icons, logs, settings, and `lib/docker/` for the Engine API, containers and updates, compose stacks, container web pages / Nginx Proxy Manager and the terminal. Nothing changes in how ArrHub works – same settings, same API, same behaviour.
- The image and package description now name every service: Radarr, Sonarr, Prowlarr, Bazarr, NZBGet, qBittorrent, Seerr and Docker.
- The installers (Debian/Ubuntu and Proxmox LXC) and the manual install steps in the README copy the new `lib/` folder.

## Upgrade

**Docker**
```bash
docker pull ghcr.io/moordrak/arrhub:1.20.1   # or :latest
docker compose up -d                           # if you use docker-compose.yml
```

**Proxmox LXC** (on the Proxmox host)
```bash
pct exec <CTID> -- bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Debian / Ubuntu**
```bash
bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/moordrak/arrhub/main/install.sh)"
```

**Manual install:** copy the new `lib/` folder too (`cp -r server.js compose.js package.json lib public /opt/arrhub/`).

Your existing `config.json` is kept.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/moordrak/arrhub/compare/v1.20.0...v1.20.1
